narr: Thunderstorms developed along a stationary front in a very moist airmass. Some on these storms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding in northern Austin. A video on Twitter showed up to six inches of water on roadways at the intersection of Shoal Creek Blvd. and Hancock Blvd. along Shoal Creek.
